title: The fill plan decides pictures and text on the quickstart-first and agent demo paths, and the size minimum reads the displayed desktop box
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-fill-plan-photo-rules.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-fill-text.test.mjs
S3: Read the exit code and the fail count of each run.
expect: Size: a 1500 pixel photo is refused for a hero whose desktop box is 1920 wide (more than 1.25 enlargement), and a hero whose file is 1920 wide but whose desktop box is 1440 takes a 1200 pixel photo.

quickstart-first: a v3 map with a brief places each card's photo by the fill plan (the offering the copy pins name), keeps an icon, never puts a stranger's face in a person slot, draws an initials avatar where no portrait fits, and reports qaEvidence placedSlots carrying the offering.

agent-demo: plan.save refuses a row whose photo differs from the fill plan's, and a photo in a substitute slot; media.import refuses another photo with AGENT_DEMO_FILL_PLAN_PHOTO and draws the initials avatar for media.import {rowIndex}; slotPhotoEvidence names the card's offering.

Text: a claim heading with a demo number and no brief fact becomes numberless ('Boxing studio'), with a founded fact it keeps that fact; a signature slot takes the signer's name, empty when nobody signs.
evidence: 29/10/2026, #141: the fill plan (#133 to #137) was used only by the editorial engine (workflow none); the quickstart-first and agent demo builds still placed pictures by their own planners and the size minimum used the demo file's natural width.
fence: Module seams with a fictional boxing studio brief and a trimmed content map; a fake pool and object store for the agent capabilities. Not exercised: a real CMS, the real host QA run, the agent model itself.
